##### Project general facts

Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an “urban lifestyle philosophy” rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces.  

Raw District stands out for its extensive and unconventional amenities, curated to foster creativity, collaboration, and community engagement. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve — forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living.

Interiors follow a clean, stripped-back design language focused on efficiency and comfort, featuring open-plan kitchens, integrated appliances, smart storage solutions, and smart home technology. The layouts are thoughtfully designed to support modern urban lifestyles, balancing practicality with understated elegance. A strong emphasis is placed on furnishing and interior detailing, with residences delivered fully furnished in a refined, minimalist style that prioritizes clarity, usability, and quiet sophistication. Additional features such as acoustic treatments, smart home integration, and high-quality fittings further elevate everyday living, ensuring each space feels cohesive, functional, and effortlessly livable.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world’s largest container hubs, which has cemented the area’s global significance in trade and commerce.

Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents.

The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.
